title: Conditional probability and multiplication theorem
notes: **Scope.** Conditional probability and multiplication theorem — Probability, Mathematics (class-12-notes).
**Tested.** define it · list: conditional probability, multiplication theorem · one worked example · one misconception each.
**Fact.** P(E) = favourable/total. Additive law: P(A∪B) = P(A)+P(B)−P(A∩B). If mutually exclusive, P(A∪B)=P(A)+P(B).
**Fact.** Multiplicative: P(A∩B) = P(A)P(B|A); independence: P(A∩B) = P(A)P(B).
**Fact.** Complement: P(A') = 1 − P(A). For discrete: ΣP = 1; expected value E(X) = Σxᵢpᵢ.
**Multiplication theorem.** one-line definition + one-line exam use.
